name: drawDash - Sketch Challenge!
original_description:
Draw a picture. Let AI guess what it is. That is the whole game.

Draw & Guess is a fun drawing guessing game you can play right inside ChatGPT. You get something to draw. You make your picture. ChatGPT looks at your drawing and tries to guess what you made. Then you can see if the AI got it right.

No art skills are needed. A wobbly cat is fine. A funny car is fine. A sun that looks like an egg is fine. In fact, silly drawings can make the game even more fun.

Each round is quick and easy. First, you get a word or thing to draw. It could be an animal, food, a place, an object, or something else you know. Then it is time to draw. Use simple lines and shapes to show your idea. When you are done, ChatGPT takes a look and makes a guess.

Did it guess right? Great. Did it get it very wrong? That can be even better.

Draw & Guess turns a simple sketch into a little game between you and AI. You do not need to write a long prompt. You do not need to know how AI works. Just start a round, draw, and see what happens.

It is a good game when you want something fast to do. Play one round while you wait. Play a few rounds when you are bored. Try to make a clear drawing, or make things hard for the AI on purpose. You choose how you want to play.
